summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Mini-Calendario Semanal feature in buildStreakCard. Seeded guest sessions on Monday+Wednesday of current week, opened share modal from home, verified generated image is 1080x1350 blob without console/page errors. Pixel-sampled the chip strip (y=940..970) and found 5590 volt pixels (~#D4FF00), confirming trained-day chips render in volt. Download button downloads racha-gymtrack.png with toast. Regression: week with no workouts still generates 1080x1350 correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: weeklyGoal=0 fallback branch in buildStreakCard is not reachable through UI: Home.js state is clamped 1-7 (init default 3, buttons min/max 1..7). The `else` branch (single centered totals card) is dead code from the UI perspective. Consider either removing it or exposing a way to reach goal=0.
test_credentials: Guest mode; seeded localStorage.gymtrack_guest_sessions with 2 sessions (Mon+Wed of current week).
seed_data_creation: Seeded 2 guest sessions on Monday & Wednesday of current week via localStorage; also gymtrack_weekly_goal=3 and gymtrack_goal_celebrated_week=<monday-ms> to suppress confetti.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mini-calendar chips render at y ~898..1002 in the 1080x1350 canvas. Sampling y=940-970 for volt pixels (r>190,g>230,b<60) is a reliable check. All flows in iteration_7 remain functional.
